question: Which of the following books was written by Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Palace of Illusions**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Palace of Illusions** was written by Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni.
 
• Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni is a renowned author known for her works that often explore Indian culture and mythology.
 
• **The Palace of Illusions** is a retelling of the Indian epic Mahabharata from the perspective of Draupadi, one of its central female characters.
 
• The book gives a voice to Draupadi and offers a fresh take on the events of the Mahabharata, focusing on her thoughts, emotions, and experiences.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni has authored several other notable works including **The Mistress of Spices** and **Sister of My Heart**.
 
• Her writing often weaves together themes of identity, immigration, and the role of women in society.
 
• Divakaruni's works have been translated into multiple languages and have received numerous literary awards.
 
• She is also a professor of Creative Writing at the University of Houston.
